safe_dispatch_assessment.safe_nonpublishing_shape: Dispatch only a branch ref (refs/heads/rust, not v* tag), select rust_tests_runner=hosted if avoiding the self-hosted tank, and native_release_build_proof=false. Release and marketplace publishers are guarded by refs/tags/v*; the branch-only native release matrix is enabled by the proof input and remains off here. The path classifier intentionally supports only push and pull_request; workflow_dispatch fails closed and sets all test/path closures changed, while already-green reuse is only considered for branch push or version tags. Thus dispatch runs the broad test graph instead of silently carrying forward this run.
safe_dispatch_assessment.exact_sha_limitation: GitHub dispatch selects a ref; current metadata did not establish that fcb7927f... is still a dispatchable branch/tag ref. Dispatching current rust may test a different SHA. No dispatch was initiated.

decision: Run 5199 is a valid green run identity, but it is not a complete baseline selector/outcome inventory. In particular it contains no native LSP test outcomes and no shard 2 results. Compare only selectors with complete matched baseline outcomes; all uncovered selectors remain unknown.
